en: Much as I'd like to welcome you in, Blunderville Square is undergoing maintenance at the moment.

en: To enter Blunderville Square, you must proceed through the quest “Just Crowning Around,” which can be undertaken by speaking with Lewena at Entrance Square.
es: Para entrar a Blunderville Square, primero tiene que hacer la misión "Just Crowning Around", que puede aceptar hablando con Lewena en Entrance Square.

en: Welcome to Blunderville Square! If you'd like to learn more about our shows, then you've come to the right place.
